units.locator: Article 24.1. Objectives of proceedings in administrative offence cases
units.text: The objectives of proceedings in administrative offence cases are the comprehensive, complete, objective and timely establishment of the circumstances of each case, its resolution in accordance with law, ensuring enforcement of the ruling issued, and identifying the causes and conditions that contributed to the commission of administrative offences.
units.label: Art. 24.1 · text

units.locator: Article 24.2. Language in which proceedings in administrative offence cases are conducted
units.text: Article 24.2. Language in which proceedings in administrative offence cases are conducted
units.label: Art. 24.2

units.locator: Article 24.2. Language in which proceedings in administrative offence cases are conducted
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 24.2. Language in which proceedings in administrative offence cases are conducted
units.label: Art. 24.2

units.locator: Article 24.2. Language in which proceedings in administrative offence cases are conducted
units.text: 1. Proceedings in administrative offence cases shall be conducted in Russian, the state language of the Russian Federation. Alongside the state language of the Russian Federation, proceedings in administrative offence cases may be conducted in the state language of the republic in whose territory the judge, body or official authorised to consider administrative offence cases is located.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 24.2

units.locator: Article 24.2. Language in which proceedings in administrative offence cases are conducted
units.text: 2. Persons participating in proceedings in an administrative offence case who do not know the language in which the proceedings are conducted shall be guaranteed the right to speak and give explanations, submit motions and challenges, and lodge complaints in their native language or another language of communication freely chosen by them, and to use the services of an interpreter.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 24.2

units.locator: Article 24.3. Public consideration of administrative offence cases
units.text: Article 24.3. Public consideration of administrative offence cases
units.label: Art. 24.3

units.locator: Article 24.3. Public consideration of administrative offence cases
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 24.3. Public consideration of administrative offence cases
units.label: Art. 24.3

units.locator: Article 24.3. Public consideration of administrative offence cases
units.text: 1. Administrative offence cases shall be considered publicly, except in the cases provided for by parts 3 and 3.1 of Article 28.6 of this Code, or where this could result in disclosure of state, military, commercial or other secrets protected by law, or where required by the interests of ensuring the safety of persons participating in proceedings in an administrative offence case, their family members and close persons, or protecting the honour and dignity of those persons.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 24.3

units.locator: Article 24.3. Public consideration of administrative offence cases
units.text: 2. A decision to consider an administrative offence case in closed session shall be made, in the form of a procedural order, by the judge, body or official considering the case.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 24.3

units.locator: Article 24.3. Public consideration of administrative offence cases
units.text: 2.1. Use of videoconferencing systems and a web-conferencing system in the closed consideration of an administrative offence case shall not be permitted.
units.label: Part 2.1 Art. 24.3

units.locator: Article 24.3. Public consideration of administrative offence cases
units.text: 3. Persons participating in proceedings in an administrative offence case and citizens present at its public consideration shall have the right to record the course of consideration in writing and by audio recording. Photography, video recording and broadcasting of the public consideration of an administrative offence case on radio, television and the Internet information and telecommunications network shall be permitted with the authorisation of the judge, body or official considering the administrative offence case.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 24.3

units.locator: Article 24.3. Public consideration of administrative offence cases
units.text: 4. The actions of citizens present at the consideration of a case who, with the authorisation of the judge, body or official considering that case, take photographs, make video recordings or broadcast the public consideration of the administrative offence case on radio, television and the Internet information and telecommunications network must not interfere with the proper conduct of consideration of the administrative offence case. Such actions may be limited in time by the judge, body or official considering the administrative offence case and must be carried out taking into account the views of the participants in proceedings in administrative offence cases and in locations designated by the judge, body or official considering that case.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 24.3

units.locator: Article 24.3.1. Informing participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case of extraprocedural communications received by a judge
units.text: Article 24.3.1. Informing participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case of extraprocedural communications received by a judge
units.label: Art. 24.3.1

units.locator: Article 24.3.1. Informing participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case of extraprocedural communications received by a judge
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 24.3.1. Informing participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case of extraprocedural communications received by a judge
units.label: Art. 24.3.1

units.locator: Article 24.3.1. Informing participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case of extraprocedural communications received by a judge
units.text: 1. Extraprocedural communications addressed to a judge handling an administrative offence case, or to the president of the court, the deputy president, the presiding judge of a judicial panel or the president of a judicial division in relation to administrative offence cases pending before the court, shall not be permitted.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 24.3.1

units.locator: Article 24.3.1. Informing participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case of extraprocedural communications received by a judge
units.text: 2. Information about extraprocedural communications from state bodies, local self-government bodies, other bodies, organisations, officials or citizens received by a judge handling an administrative offence case, or by the president of the court, the deputy president, the presiding judge of a judicial panel or the president of a judicial division in relation to administrative offence cases pending before the court, shall be made public and brought to the attention of participants in the proceedings by posting that information on the court’s official website on the Internet. Such communications shall not constitute grounds for procedural actions or procedural decisions in administrative offence cases.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 24.3.1

units.locator: Article 24.4. Motions
units.text: Article 24.4. Motions
units.label: Art. 24.4

units.locator: Article 24.4. Motions
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 24.4. Motions
units.label: Art. 24.4

units.locator: Article 24.4. Motions
units.text: 1. Persons participating in proceedings in an administrative offence case shall have the right to submit motions, which must be considered by the judge, body or official handling the case.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 24.4

units.locator: Article 24.4. Motions
units.text: 2. A motion shall be submitted in writing and shall be considered immediately. A decision refusing to grant a motion shall be made, in the form of a procedural order, by the judge, body or official handling the administrative offence case.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 24.4

units.locator: Article 24.5. Circumstances precluding proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: Article 24.5. Circumstances precluding proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 24.5

units.locator: Article 24.5. Circumstances precluding proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 24.5. Circumstances precluding proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 24.5

units.locator: Article 24.5. Circumstances precluding proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 1. Proceedings in an administrative offence case may not be initiated, and proceedings already initiated shall be terminated, where at least one of the following circumstances exists:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 24.5

units.locator: Article 24.5. Circumstances precluding proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 1) absence of the event of an administrative offence;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 24.5

units.locator: Article 24.5. Circumstances precluding proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 2) absence of the constituent elements of an administrative offence, including where an individual had not, at the time of the unlawful action or omission, attained the age specified by this Code for administrative liability (except in the case provided for by part 3 of this Article), or where the individual who committed the unlawful action or omission was legally insane;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 24.5

units.locator: Article 24.5. Circumstances precluding proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 3) action by a person in a state of extreme necessity;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 24.5

units.locator: Article 24.5. Circumstances precluding proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 4) issuance of an amnesty act, if that act removes the application of an administrative penalty;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 24.5

units.locator: Article 24.5. Circumstances precluding proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 5) repeal of a law or provision thereof establishing administrative liability for the act, except where provisions of a law abolishing administrative liability for the act and establishing criminal liability for the same act enter into force simultaneously;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 24.5

units.locator: Article 24.5. Circumstances precluding proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 5.1) commission of an administrative offence consisting in non-compliance with mandatory requirements contained in regulatory legal acts, where, under parts 3, 4 and 7 of Article 15 of Federal Law of 31 July 2020 No. 247-FZ “On Mandatory Requirements in the Russian Federation”, such non-compliance cannot constitute grounds for administrative liability;
units.label: Point 5.1 Part 1 Art. 24.5

units.locator: Article 24.5. Circumstances precluding proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 5.2) recognition of the agreement referred to in part 1 of Article 2.9.1 of this Code as performed;
units.label: Point 5.2 Part 1 Art. 24.5

units.locator: Article 24.5. Circumstances precluding proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 6) expiry of the limitation periods for imposing administrative liability;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 24.5

units.locator: Article 24.5. Circumstances precluding proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 7) existence, in respect of the same instance of unlawful action or omission by the person against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted, of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty, a ruling terminating proceedings in an administrative offence case under the same article or the same part of an article of this Code or a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, or a decision to initiate a criminal case;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 24.5

units.locator: Article 24.5. Circumstances precluding proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 8) death of the individual against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted;
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 24.5

units.locator: Article 24.5. Circumstances precluding proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 8.1) entry in the Unified State Register of Legal Entities of a record of liquidation of the legal entity against which proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted, based on a commercial court procedural order concluding liquidation bankruptcy proceedings under insolvency (bankruptcy) legislation;
units.label: Point 8.1 Part 1 Art. 24.5

units.locator: Article 24.5. Circumstances precluding proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 9) other circumstances provided for by this Code under which a person who has committed an action or omission containing the constituent elements of an administrative offence is exempted from administrative liability.
units.label: Point 9 Part 1 Art. 24.5

units.locator: Article 24.5. Circumstances precluding proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 2. Where an administrative offence has been committed by a person referred to in part 1 of Article 2.5 of this Code, except where that person bears administrative liability on general grounds for that administrative offence, proceedings in the administrative offence case shall, after all circumstances of its commission have been established, be terminated so that the person may be subjected to disciplinary liability.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 24.5

units.locator: Article 24.5. Circumstances precluding proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 3. Where an administrative offence connected with driving a vehicle is detected and the individual had not, at the time of the unlawful action, attained the age specified by this Code for administrative liability, proceedings in the administrative offence case shall be terminated after the measures securing proceedings that are necessary to stop the unlawful action have been applied.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 24.5

units.locator: Article 24.5. Circumstances precluding proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 4. If, during proceedings in an administrative offence case concerning failure to exercise or improper exercise of the powers of a state authority of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation or a local self-government body, or failure by a state or municipal institution to perform its statutory tasks or its improper performance thereof, it is established that the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, the chair of its highest executive body, another official of its executive body, the head of a municipal entity heading the local administration, another local self-government official, or the head of a state or municipal institution submitted or sent, in accordance with the procedure and deadlines for preparing the draft budget of the relevant constituent entity of the Russian Federation or the relevant local budget, a proposal to allocate budget appropriations for the exercise of those powers of the state authority of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation or local self-government body, or for the performance of the relevant statutory tasks by the state or municipal institution, and appropriations for those purposes were not allocated or were allocated in an amount insufficient to exercise those powers or perform those statutory tasks, resulting in non-exercise or improper exercise of the powers or non-performance or improper performance of the statutory tasks, proceedings in the administrative offence case against those bodies, institutions and their officials shall be terminated.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 24.5

units.locator: Article 24.5. Circumstances precluding proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 5. If, during proceedings in an administrative offence case concerning failure to exercise or improper exercise of state powers delegated to state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation or local self-government bodies, it is established that subventions for the exercise of those powers were allocated in an amount insufficient for their exercise, resulting in non-exercise or improper exercise of those powers, proceedings in that administrative offence case against those bodies and their officials shall be terminated.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 24.5

units.locator: Article 24.6. Prosecutorial supervision
units.text: Article 24.6. Prosecutorial supervision
units.label: Art. 24.6

units.locator: Article 24.6. Prosecutorial supervision
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 24.6. Prosecutorial supervision
units.label: Art. 24.6

units.locator: Article 24.6. Prosecutorial supervision
units.text: The Prosecutor General of the Russian Federation and prosecutors appointed by the Prosecutor General shall, within their competence, supervise compliance with the Constitution of the Russian Federation and the implementation of laws in force in the Russian Federation during proceedings in administrative offence cases, except cases pending before a court.
units.label: Art. 24.6 · text

units.locator: Article 24.7. Costs in an administrative offence case
units.text: Article 24.7. Costs in an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 24.7

units.locator: Article 24.7. Costs in an administrative offence case
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 24.7. Costs in an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 24.7

units.locator: Article 24.7. Costs in an administrative offence case
units.text: 1. Costs in an administrative offence case shall consist of:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 24.7

units.locator: Article 24.7. Costs in an administrative offence case
units.text: 1) amounts paid to witnesses, victims, their legal representatives, attesting witnesses, specialists, experts and interpreters, including amounts paid to cover travel, accommodation rental and additional expenses associated with living away from the permanent place of residence (daily allowances);
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 24.7

units.locator: Article 24.7. Costs in an administrative offence case
units.text: 2) amounts spent on dismantling, storing, transporting (forwarding) and examining physical evidence, the instrument used to commit an administrative offence or the object of the administrative offence;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 24.7

units.locator: Article 24.7. Costs in an administrative offence case
units.text: 3) amounts paid for legal assistance to defence counsel appointed by the judge, body or official considering the administrative offence case in accordance with part 6 of Article 25.5 of this Code, including amounts paid to cover travel, accommodation rental and additional expenses associated with living away from the permanent place of residence (daily allowances).
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 24.7

units.locator: Article 24.7. Costs in an administrative offence case
units.text: 2. Costs in a case concerning an administrative offence committed by an individual and provided for by this Code shall be charged to the federal budget, and costs in a case concerning an administrative offence committed by an individual and provided for by a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation shall be charged to the budget of that constituent entity of the Russian Federation, except in the cases provided for by parts 3 and 3.1 of this Article.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 24.7

units.locator: Article 24.7. Costs in an administrative offence case
units.text: 3. Costs in a case concerning an administrative offence committed by a legal entity or an individual entrepreneur shall be charged to those persons, except amounts paid to an interpreter. Amounts paid to an interpreter in connection with consideration of a case concerning an administrative offence committed by a legal entity or an individual entrepreneur and provided for by this Code shall be charged to the federal budget, and costs in a case concerning an administrative offence committed by a legal entity or an individual entrepreneur and provided for by a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation shall be charged to the budget of that constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 24.7

units.locator: Article 24.7. Costs in an administrative offence case
units.text: Where proceedings in an administrative offence case against a legal entity or an individual entrepreneur are terminated on the grounds provided for by points 1 - 3, 5, 7, 8 and 8.1 of part 1 of Article 24.5 of this Code, the costs of the administrative offence case shall be charged to the federal budget; and where proceedings in a case concerning an administrative offence provided for by a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation are terminated against a legal entity or an individual entrepreneur on those grounds, the costs shall be charged to the budget of the relevant constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 24.7 · “Where proceedings in an administrative offence case against a…”

units.locator: Article 24.7. Costs in an administrative offence case
units.text: 3.1. Costs in an administrative offence case specified in point 3 of part 1 of this Article shall be charged to the person held administratively liable, except where proceedings against that person are terminated on the grounds provided for by points 1 - 3, 5, 7, 8 and 8.1 of part 1 of Article 24.5 of this Code.
units.label: Part 3.1 Art. 24.7

units.locator: Article 24.7. Costs in an administrative offence case
units.text: Where proceedings are terminated, on the grounds provided for by points 1 - 3, 5, 7, 8 and 8.1 of part 1 of Article 24.5 of this Code, against a person who is outside the Russian Federation at the time the administrative offence case is considered, in a case concerning an administrative offence committed outside the Russian Federation and provided for by Article 13.14.1, 13.15, 13.36, 13.37, 13.48, 17.13 or 19.34, part 3, 4 or 5 of Article 20.1, or Article 20.3.1, 20.3.2, 20.3.3, 20.3.4, 20.29 or 20.33 of this Code, or an administrative offence consisting in failure to pay within the period specified by this Code an administrative fine imposed for such an administrative offence, the costs in the administrative offence case shall be charged to the federal budget.
units.label: Part 3.1 Art. 24.7 · “Where proceedings are terminated, on the grounds provided for…”

units.locator: Article 24.7. Costs in an administrative offence case
units.text: 4. The amount of costs in an administrative offence case shall be determined on the basis of documents included in the case file evidencing the existence and amount of expenses classified as costs.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 24.7

units.locator: Article 24.7. Costs in an administrative offence case
units.text: The decision on costs in an administrative offence case shall be reflected in the ruling imposing an administrative penalty or the ruling terminating proceedings in the administrative offence case.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 24.7 · “The decision on costs in an administrative offence case shall…”

units.locator: Article 24.8. Submission of procedural documents by participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: Article 24.8. Submission of procedural documents by participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 24.8

units.locator: Article 24.8. Submission of procedural documents by participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 24.8. Submission of procedural documents by participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 24.8

units.locator: Article 24.8. Submission of procedural documents by participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 1. Applications, motions, complaints, protests and other documents may be submitted by participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case on paper or, where the court, body or official handling the case has the technical capability, electronically, including in the form of an electronic document. Where applications, motions, complaints, protests or other documents are submitted electronically, including in the form of an electronic document, their attachments must also be submitted electronically, including in the form of an electronic document.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 24.8

units.locator: Article 24.8. Submission of procedural documents by participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 2. Applications, motions, complaints, protests and other documents prepared electronically, including in the form of an electronic document, and their attachments may be submitted to a court by a participant in proceedings in an administrative offence case through the federal state information system “Unified Portal of State and Municipal Services (Functions)” (hereinafter, the Unified Portal), through an information system designated by the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation or the Judicial Department at the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation, or through the electronic document management systems of participants in proceedings in administrative offence cases using the unified system of interdepartmental electronic interaction.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 24.8

units.locator: Article 24.8. Submission of procedural documents by participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 3. Applications, motions, complaints, protests and other documents submitted to a court through the Unified Portal or an information system designated by the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation or the Judicial Department at the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation may be signed with a simple electronic signature unless this Code requires them to be signed with an enhanced qualified electronic signature.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 24.8

units.locator: Article 24.8. Submission of procedural documents by participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: Applications, motions, complaints, protests and other documents submitted to a court through the electronic document management systems of participants in proceedings in administrative offence cases must be signed with an enhanced qualified electronic signature.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 24.8 · “Applications, motions, complaints, protests and other documents…”

units.locator: Article 24.8. Submission of procedural documents by participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 4. Applications, motions, complaints, protests and other documents prepared electronically, including in the form of an electronic document, and their attachments may be submitted by participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case to the body or official handling the case through the Unified Portal, through the personal account of a legal entity or individual entrepreneur located on the official website of a state body, the monitoring information system operator or the Bank of Russia on the Internet information and telecommunications network (hereinafter, the personal account of a legal entity or individual entrepreneur), or through the electronic document management systems of participants in proceedings in administrative offence cases using the unified system of interdepartmental electronic interaction.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 24.8

units.locator: Article 24.8. Submission of procedural documents by participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: The documents referred to in the first paragraph of this part may also be submitted by participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case, through regional portals of state and municipal services (functions) (hereinafter, regional portals), to executive bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, commissions on minors’ affairs and protection of their rights, administrative commissions, other collegial bodies established under the laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, state institutions subordinate to executive bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, local self-government bodies and their officials handling the case.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 24.8 · “The documents referred to in the first paragraph of this part…”

units.locator: Article 24.8. Submission of procedural documents by participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: 5. Applications, motions, complaints, protests and other documents submitted through the Unified Portal to the body or official handling an administrative offence case may be signed with a simple electronic signature unless this Code requires them to be signed with an enhanced qualified electronic signature.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 24.8
